name: Mercury Scales (Dorian) — 7-email Hormozi $100M Leads (EN, founder-to-founder, pay-on-results)
target: Self-made B2B founders scaling client acquisition past ~$15k/mo: AI/automation agency owners, high-ticket sales/closing coaches, business/sales/marketing coaches, money & mindset educators. English-speaking (US/UK/CA/AU) + Germany. Solo or lean teams of 1-10.
voice_notes: Founder-to-founder, no agency-speak, no hype, no exclamation marks, no guru language, no fake scarcity. One concrete question per email. Risk-reversal: you only pay when we beat your current client-acquisition numbers. Required merge: {first_name} (company is optional; many targets are personal brands). NO em dashes.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from the previous step. 0,2,2,3,4,7,10 = days 0,2,4,7,11,18,28.

variants.subject: open to this?
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

quick one, are you open to something?

I work with founders who already have an offer that converts and want client acquisition that runs without them babysitting it.

One AI-automation founder went from 6 booked calls a month to 19 in about 7 weeks, same offer, same price. Another closing coach filled their calendar 3 weeks out.

The part most people like: you only pay once we beat the acquisition numbers you are doing right now. Until then, nothing.

Worth 15 minutes?

Reply with where most of your clients come from today and I will tell you straight if we can move it.

Dorian

P.s. a plain no is completely fine if the timing is off.

variants.subject: had a look at what you do
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

had a look at what you are building.

We run client acquisition for founders and you only pay when we beat your current numbers. No retainer riding on hope.

15 minutes this week?

Dorian

variants.subject: 19 calls from 6
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

one data point.

An AI-automation founder we work with went from 6 booked calls a month to 19 in roughly 7 weeks. Same offer, same price, just a system that actually runs.

The same approach would map onto what you are doing.

Dorian

variants.subject: you are probably slammed
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

me again, fourth email, you are clearly busy so I will be quick.

Problem: if you want 5 to 15 more qualified calls a month this quarter, dialing in the acquisition takes a stupid amount of your time.

Solution: 15 minutes and I will show you exactly how we beat a founder's existing numbers in 23 days without them touching it.

When works?

Dorian

variants.subject: {first_name}, yes or no
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

if we beat your current 30-day client-acquisition numbers and you only paid once we did, is that a yes?

A clear yes or no both work.

Dorian

variants.subject: free teardown either way
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

whether you ever work with me or not, this is yours.

I will record a short teardown of your current client-acquisition funnel and where the booked calls are leaking, in your inbox within 48 hours. No call needed.

Want it?

Dorian

variants.subject: closing your file
variants.body:
Hey {first_name},

closing your file on my end today since I only take a couple of new founders at a time.

If the timing is wrong, I get it. If the offer is not a fit, just say so. Otherwise I will stop reaching out.

Dorian
